parameter_draws.calibration_notice: Local-normal mixing on the selected active-bound face, truncated by inactive box limits, in explicit optimization coordinates. Conditions on the selected likelihood basin and fixes active loading/deviation bounds; excludes released-bound/profile branches, model selection and initial/bin convention uncertainty. Not calibrated simultaneous confidence or a posterior distribution. Combine with hard unknown-run nuisance ranges and separately reported model/initial/profile sensitivities; empirical gain-LR recovery tests do not validate this whole mixture.
